name: Red Team Infrastructure & Operations
tagline: Authorized red team tooling: pivoting, tunnels, proxying, and practice lab environments.

tools.name: sshuttle
tools.desc: Lightweight VPN-like pivot using SSH; routes traffic through a jump host without requiring root on the target.
tools.when: Need simple, reliable lateral routing to access internal networks from a single jump host during authorized engagements or labs.

tools.name: chisel
tools.desc: Fast TCP/HTTP tunneling over a single port with reverse or forward modes; portable and minimal.
tools.when: Tunneling a specific service through restrictive firewalls or NAT during controlled testing.

tools.name: ligolo-ng
tools.desc: TUN-based tunneling agent for pivoting with automatic routes; simple interface for authorized red team operations.
tools.when: Need full network access through a pivot host with automatic routing in a lab or authorized engagement environment.

tools.name: frp
tools.desc: Fast reverse proxy for exposing local services through a remote server; stable and well-documented.
tools.when: Need controlled reverse proxying for lab infrastructure or authorized test setups behind NAT.

tools.name: proxychains-ng
tools.desc: Force any TCP application through a chain of proxies for controlled routing in authorized testing.
tools.when: Need to route existing tooling through a proxy chain during authorized red team exercises or lab scenarios.
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/rofl0r/proxychains-ng && cd proxychains-ng && ./configure --prefix=/usr && make && sudo make install

tools.name: GOAD
tools.desc: Great Oxide Active Directory lab for realistic, authorized red team practice with vulnerable AD domains.
tools.when: Practicing authorized AD attack/defense techniques in an isolated, controlled lab environment.

tools.name: VECTR
tools.desc: Purple team tracking and assessment framework for mapping techniques to MITRE ATT&CK in controlled exercises.
tools.when: Running structured, authorized red/purple team exercises with measurable objectives and reporting.
